- **Probable Dengue Fever (without warning signs)** – The patient has a high fever > 38.5 °C for 3 days, severe headache, retro‑orbital pain, body ache, nausea and a maculopapular rash on the chest, which are classic clinical features of dengue. No bleeding, abdominal pain, altered mental status or other warning signs are reported, satisfying the “dengue without warning signs” condition used for home management (CARD DEN‑ADV‑001)【DEN‑ADV‑001, p.11】.  
- **Chikungunya fever – less likely** – Although fever and rash are present, the case does not describe the required severe poly‑arthralgia/arthritis that is a prerequisite for suspecting chikungunya (CARD CHIK‑DX‑001)【CHIK‑DX‑001, p.1】.
